resources.title: The Data Science Lifecycle Infographic (1 of 4)
resources.description: What data science actually is and how it's practiced end to end, framed around a real project: Northfield Retail wants to predict which customers are likely to churn. Covers the key skills used (SQL, Python, statistics, machine learning, visualization, cloud & MLOps), the 6-step lifecycle (define, get data, explore/EDA, build model, evaluate, deploy & use), the data flow and architecture from source systems through SQL/Python into cloud deployment and Power BI insights, a real churn-prediction example (inputs and a sample 0.87 risk-score output), sample SQL for pulling the data, sample Python for training a model, and example model-evaluation results.

resources.title: Statistics & Machine Learning Explained Infographic (2 of 4)
resources.description: The foundations that turn data into predictions: the data science knowledge stack (SQL -> Python -> statistics -> machine learning -> business impact), key statistics concepts (descriptive statistics, probability, distributions, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression), the three machine learning approaches (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning) with real examples, a comparison of popular ML algorithms (decision tree, random forest, XGBoost/LightGBM, SVM, K-means) and what each is best for, a visual guide to classification/regression/clustering problem types, sample Python for training a classification model, and the key model evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC) explained in plain language.

resources.title: Building a Customer Churn Prediction Model Infographic (3 of 4)
resources.description: A complete, real machine learning project from business question to business impact: the 5-step workflow (prepare the data, explore/EDA, build the model, evaluate performance, deliver the result), the actual dataset schema used, real SQL to pull customer data for modeling, real EDA charts showing churn rate by tenure/spend/support tickets/satisfaction, real Python code training a Random Forest classifier with scikit-learn, model results (94% accuracy, 0.96 ROC-AUC), feature-importance rankings showing what actually drives churn, a real customer-level churn-probability table with recommended actions, and the measured business impact (15% churn reduction, $480K revenue retained, 3.4x ROI).

resources.title: Production Data Science: Azure ML, AWS SageMaker & MLOps Infographic (4 of 4)
resources.description: Taking a model from notebook demo to a real, scalable business solution: the 6-step MLOps lifecycle (prepare, train, register, deploy, monitor, retrain), a side-by-side comparison of Azure ML vs. AWS SageMaker (build & train, deploy, model registry, monitoring, CI/CD), a full production architecture reference diagram, sample Python code deploying a model as a real endpoint, key production concepts (model registry, CI/CD for ML, model drift, governance), a real model-monitoring dashboard example tracking accuracy/precision/recall/F1 over time, a complete MLOps toolchain example (GitHub -> Azure DevOps -> Kubernetes -> Grafana/Azure Monitor), and the measured business outcomes of running this in production.
